ram:a00df4d4.comment: This function polls a status register at 0xc00b0014 until bit 0x20 is set, then writes a byte parameter to the register at 0xc00b0000. ram:a0113064.comment: This function clears bits in two memory-mapped registers at 0xcf011800 and 0xcf011a00. If the input parameter is 0xff, it scans bits 0-4 of the original value from 0xcf011a00, calling the external function for each set bit and clearing that bit in both registers. Otherwise, it clears the bit corresponding to the input parameter in both registers. The function always returns 0.
